messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

Short answer: compared with 24 GHz automotive radar frontends at 24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 250 MHz instantaneous bandwidth, the supported modern radar configurations operate at 76 GHz to 81 GHz with 1 GHz, 2 GHz, 4 GHz, or 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, so VNA needs shift toward mmWave frequency coverage, GHz-span characterization, high dynamic range, coherent multiport operation, stricter calibration/de-embedding, and related PCB/material characterization workflows [44][43][45][50].
### Frequency range
The R&S ZNA base family covers 10 MHz to a maximum of 67 GHz [6].
The R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz [16].
### Bandwidth and dynamic range
The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option, with measured overrange values of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz, and 5.2 GHz [50].
The AREG800A IF frequency range is listed as 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and also 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz under the noted option-code ambiguity [50].
AREG800A VNA measurement conditions for IF transfer characteristics use 1 kHz measurement bandwidth and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [40].
AREG800A ghost-object suppression is measured with a VNA in time domain using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [39].
ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the increased IF bandwidth option [7].
ZNA analog frontend bandwidth is 50 MHz nominal from 10 MHz to 5 GHz and 2 GHz nominal from 5 GHz to 67 GHz [7].
ZNA67EXT measurement bandwidths are 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz [10].
ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified above 100 dB from 75 GHz to 80 GHz and above 105 dB from 80 GHz to 90 GHz [9].
AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed conventional frontends and 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path [40].
【推論】Wider radar instantaneous bandwidth increases the need to characterize GHz-wide transfer behavior, but the cited VNA measurement bandwidth remains a receiver/noise-speed setting rather than the same thing as 5 GHz radar instantaneous bandwidth [50][40][39][7][10].
### Multiport and coherent measurement
AREG800A radar production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels depending on configuration [42].
AREG800A supports up to four conventional mmWave frontends per base unit [50].
AREG800A supports up to eight QAT100 frontends and up to eight FE44S external frontends, listed as four TX and four RX pairs [50].
A 4-port ZNA has up to four independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources and eight true receivers without multiplexing [1].
ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array tests and antenna test systems from 100 kHz [1].
ZNA mmWave converter support allows two converters with a 2-port ZNA or four converters with a 4-port ZNA in the recommended setup [8].
ZNA67EXT has 2-port and 4-port variants, including 4-port systems with four millimeterwave converter heads [11].
### Calibration and de-embedding
ZNA67EXT effective system data is valid only between +18 °C and +28 °C, with temperature after calibration varied by no more than 1 °C [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data requires frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be identical between calibration and measurement, with no interpolation [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data is based on 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm nominal source power, and the R&S ZN-Z210 calibration kit [13].
ZNA67EXT specifications apply only when operated as a 1.0 mm VNA system with the system configuration matching the R&S ZNA67 rear-panel designation scheme, serial numbers, and correct port positions [14].
ZNL measurement accuracy requires +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change not exceeding 1 °C, TOSM/SOLT calibration, and identical frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time between calibration and measurement [57].
ZNA67EXT software options include Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].
### Material and radome measurements
The passages support material measurement through N1500A plus ENA/PNA advanced material measurement solutions and N1500A Materials Measurement Suite [26].
That material-measurement flow is described as measuring raw materials such as substrates or laminates for Dk/Df [26].
The PCB flow lists material selection measurements of insertion loss, surface roughness, and Dk/Df [31].
The PCB sampling-test flow lists insertion loss, impedance variation, and Dk/Df extraction using ENA/PNA-based Delta-L loss and TDR impedance measurement [31].
### Signal integrity
The cited PCB test flow includes material characterization, material selection, board sampling testing, and mass-production monitoring [31].
The board sampling step measures insertion loss, impedance variation, and material characteristics such as Dk/Df [31].
The listed ENA/PNA workflow includes Delta-L loss, TDR impedance measurement, and Dk/Df extraction [29].
ZNA software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, and true differential mode [4].
ZNA67EXT software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].

AREG800A ghost-object suppression is measured with a VNA in time domain using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [39].
ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the increased IF bandwidth option [7].
ZNA analog frontend bandwidth is 50 MHz nominal from 10 MHz to 5 GHz and 2 GHz nominal from 5 GHz to 67 GHz [7].
ZNA67EXT measurement bandwidths are 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz [10].
ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified above 100 dB from 75 GHz to 80 GHz and above 105 dB from 80 GHz to 90 GHz [9].
AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed conventional frontends and 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path [40].
【推論】Wider radar instantaneous bandwidth increases the need to characterize GHz-wide transfer behavior, but the cited VNA measurement bandwidth remains a receiver/noise-speed setting rather than the same thing as 5 GHz radar instantaneous bandwidth [50][40][39][7][10].
### Multiport and coherent measurement
AREG800A radar production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels depending on configuration [42].
AREG800A supports up to four conventional mmWave frontends per base unit [50].
AREG800A supports up to eight QAT100 frontends and up to eight FE44S external frontends, listed as four TX and four RX pairs [50].
A 4-port ZNA has up to four independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources and eight true receivers without multiplexing [1].
ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array tests and antenna test systems from 100 kHz [1].
ZNA mmWave converter support allows two converters with a 2-port ZNA or four converters with a 4-port ZNA in the recommended setup [8].
ZNA67EXT has 2-port and 4-port variants, including 4-port systems with four millimeterwave converter heads [11].
### Calibration and de-embedding
ZNA67EXT effective system data is valid only between +18 °C and +28 °C, with temperature after calibration varied by no more than 1 °C [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data requires frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be identical between calibration and measurement, with no interpolation [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data is based on 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm nominal source power, and the R&S ZN-Z210 calibration kit [13].
ZNA67EXT specifications apply only when operated as a 1.0 mm VNA system with the system configuration matching the R&S ZNA67 rear-panel designation scheme, serial numbers, and correct port positions [14].
ZNL measurement accuracy requires +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change not exceeding 1 °C, TOSM/SOLT calibration, and identical frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time between calibration and measurement [57].
ZNA67EXT software options include Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].
### Material and radome measurements
The passages support material measurement through N1500A plus ENA/PNA advanced material measurement solutions and N1500A Materials Measurement Suite [26].
That material-measurement flow is described as measuring raw materials such as substrates or laminates for Dk/Df [26].
The PCB flow lists material selection measurements of insertion loss, surface roughness, and Dk/Df [31].
The PCB sampling-test flow lists insertion loss, impedance variation, and Dk/Df extraction using ENA/PNA-based Delta-L loss and TDR impedance measurement [31].
### Signal integrity
The cited PCB test flow includes material characterization, material selection, board sampling testing, and mass-production monitoring [31].
The board sampling step measures insertion loss, impedance variation, and material characteristics such as Dk/Df [31].
The listed ENA/PNA workflow includes Delta-L loss, TDR impedance measurement, and Dk/Df extraction [29].
ZNA software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, and true differential mode [4].
ZNA67EXT software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA › Dynamic range 與 noise level 摘錄
- Dynamic range 定義：receiver noise floor 是 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS value，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，條件為 test ports short-circuited。
- Specification 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，未套用 user correction；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；來源說明 crosstalk 不限制 dynamic range。
- R&S®ZNA-B3n 條件下，receiver step attenuator 為 0 dB position；n 代表 port number 1/2/3/4。
- R&S®ZNA26/43/50/67 的 system dynamic range，1 GHz to 16 GHz：spec. > 129 dB、typ. 139 dB；meas. spec. > 137 dB、typ. meas. 147 dB。
- R&S®ZNA50/R&S®ZNA67，40 GHz to 50 GHz：spec. > 106 dB、typ. 116 dB；meas. spec. > 112 dB、typ. meas. 122 dB。

- Standard configuration noise level，1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz，base unit 500 MHz to 30 GHz：spec. < –120 dBm、typ. –132 dBm。
- Standard configuration noise level，1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz，base unit 50 GHz to 67 GHz：spec. < –104 dBm、typ. –119 dBm。
- Reversed coupler configuration，base unit + R&S®ZNAxx-B16 + R&S®ZNAxx-B3n，50 GHz to 67 GHz：spec. < –116 dBm、typ. –130 dBm。

R&S ZNA › Frequency accuracy 與 measurement bandwidth
- Static frequency accuracy 公式：time since last adjustment in years × aging per year + temperature drift + achievable initial calibration accuracy。
- Aging per year：standard ±1 × 10–6；with [[R&S ZNA-B4]] precision frequency reference option ±1 × 10–7。
- Temperature drift（+5 °C to +40 °C）：standard ±1 × 10–6；with [[R&S ZNA-B4]] ±1 × 10–8。
- Achievable initial calibration accuracy：standard ±5 × 10–7；with [[R&S ZNA-B4]] ±5 × 10–8。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Analog frontend bandwidth：10 MHz to 5 GHz 為 50 MHz nominal；5 GHz to 67 GHz 為 2 GHz nominal。

R&S ZNA › 重要 recommended setups
- [[R&S ZNA-K5]] vector corrected converter measurements：recommended setup 為 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K4、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-B8 mmWave converter LO、R&S®ZN-ZM292 calibration mixer 與 calibration accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support：two mmWave converters with 2-port R&S®ZNA，或 four mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNA-B8、R&S®ZNA-B26、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。Alternative setup：two mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA，需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。

- [[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement：recommended setup 使用 port 1 as driving and port 2 as receiving port；需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZNAxx-B21、R&S®ZNAxx-B32、R&S®ZNAxx-B161、R&S®ZNAxx-B302、diode power sensor（例如 R&S®NRP40S）與 accessories（test cables、fixed attenuators 3 dB / 6 dB / 10 dB 等）。

條件：receiver noise floor 為 transmission magnitude data trace RMS，test ports short-circuited；規格適用於 **10 Hz measurement bandwidth**，without user correction applied。來源說明 dynamic range 可用 **1 Hz measurement bandwidth** 增加；crosstalk does not limit the dynamic range。Dynamic range performance specified between port 1 and port 2 and between port 3 and port 4（4-port model）；otherwise typical。

Product data 適用條件：

Short answer: compared with 24 GHz automotive radar frontends at 24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz and 250 MHz instantaneous bandwidth, the supported modern radar configurations operate at 76 GHz to 81 GHz with 1 GHz, 2 GHz, 4 GHz, or 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth, so VNA needs shift toward mmWave frequency coverage, GHz-span characterization, high dynamic range, coherent multiport operation, stricter calibration/de-embedding, and related PCB/material characterization workflows [44][43][45][50].
### Frequency range
The R&S ZNA base family covers 10 MHz to a maximum of 67 GHz [6].
The R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz [16].
### Bandwidth and dynamic range
The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option, with measured overrange values of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz, and 5.2 GHz [50].
The AREG800A IF frequency range is listed as 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and also 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz under the noted option-code ambiguity [50].
AREG800A VNA measurement conditions for IF transfer characteristics use 1 kHz measurement bandwidth and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [40].
AREG800A ghost-object suppression is measured with a VNA in time domain using 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [39].
ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz in the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the increased IF bandwidth option [7].
ZNA analog frontend bandwidth is 50 MHz nominal from 10 MHz to 5 GHz and 2 GHz nominal from 5 GHz to 67 GHz [7].
ZNA67EXT measurement bandwidths are 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz [10].
ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified above 100 dB from 75 GHz to 80 GHz and above 105 dB from 80 GHz to 90 GHz [9].
AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed conventional frontends and 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path [40].
【推論】Wider radar instantaneous bandwidth increases the need to characterize GHz-wide transfer behavior, but the cited VNA measurement bandwidth remains a receiver/noise-speed setting rather than the same thing as 5 GHz radar instantaneous bandwidth [50][40][39][7][10].
### Multiport and coherent measurement
AREG800A radar production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels depending on configuration [42].
AREG800A supports up to four conventional mmWave frontends per base unit [50].
AREG800A supports up to eight QAT100 frontends and up to eight FE44S external frontends, listed as four TX and four RX pairs [50].
A 4-port ZNA has up to four independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources and eight true receivers without multiplexing [1].
ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array tests and antenna test systems from 100 kHz [1].
ZNA mmWave converter support allows two converters with a 2-port ZNA or four converters with a 4-port ZNA in the recommended setup [8].
ZNA67EXT has 2-port and 4-port variants, including 4-port systems with four millimeterwave converter heads [11].
### Calibration and de-embedding
ZNA67EXT effective system data is valid only between +18 °C and +28 °C, with temperature after calibration varied by no more than 1 °C [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data requires frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time to be identical between calibration and measurement, with no interpolation [13].
ZNA67EXT effective system data is based on 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm nominal source power, and the R&S ZN-Z210 calibration kit [13].
ZNA67EXT specifications apply only when operated as a 1.0 mm VNA system with the system configuration matching the R&S ZNA67 rear-panel designation scheme, serial numbers, and correct port positions [14].
ZNL measurement accuracy requires +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change not exceeding 1 °C, TOSM/SOLT calibration, and identical frequency points, measurement bandwidth, and sweep time between calibration and measurement [57].
ZNA67EXT software options include Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].
### Material and radome measurements
The passages support material measurement through N1500A plus ENA/PNA advanced material measurement solutions and N1500A Materials Measurement Suite [26].
That material-measurement flow is described as measuring raw materials such as substrates or laminates for Dk/Df [26].
The PCB flow lists material selection measurements of insertion loss, surface roughness, and Dk/Df [31].
The PCB sampling-test flow lists insertion loss, impedance variation, and Dk/Df extraction using ENA/PNA-based Delta-L loss and TDR impedance measurement [31].
### Signal integrity
The cited PCB test flow includes material characterization, material selection, board sampling testing, and mass-production monitoring [31].
The board sampling step measures insertion loss, impedance variation, and material characteristics such as Dk/Df [31].
The listed ENA/PNA workflow includes Delta-L loss, TDR impedance measurement, and Dk/Df extraction [29].
ZNA software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, and true differential mode [4].
ZNA67EXT software options include time-domain analysis, extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram, Easy deembedding, In-situ deembedding, Smart fixture deembedding, and Delta-L PCB characterization [12].

- 溫度 +18 °C to +28 °C。
- Calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C。
- 依 port connector 使用 [[R&S ZV-Z270]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z235]] calibration kit。
- Calibration method：TOSM/SOLT。
- Frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 在 measurement 與 calibration 時必須相同。
- 不允許 interpolation。

Effective system data 另基於 source power –10 dBm、measurement bandwidth 10 Hz。

| 項目 | 5 kHz to 10 GHz | 10 GHz to 20 GHz |
|---|---:|---:|
| Directivity | ≥ 46 dB | ≥ 42 dB |
| Source match | ≥ 40 dB | ≥ 37 dB |
| Load match | ≥ 42 dB | ≥ 38 dB |
| Reflection tracking | ≤ 0.07 dB | ≤ 0.09 dB |
| Transmission tracking | ≤ 0.06 dB | ≤ 0.06 dB |

Factory-calibrated system data 條件：+18 °C to +28 °C、source power –10 dBm、measurement bandwidth 1 kHz。Directivity 100 kHz to 20 GHz specification ≥ 20 dB / typical 35 dB；source match 100 kHz to 20 GHz specification ≥ 20 dB / typical 35 dB。
